concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading an experimental $T_g$ dataset and producing a CSV containing $T_g$ values. Task T003 only creates an empty placeholder when the dataset is unavailable and never yields actual $T_g$ data, leaving the functional requirement unmet.

FR-003 mandates training an Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM). Tasks T007 and T008 are conditional on the presence of a non‑empty $T_g$ column, which is never produced because FR-001 is unmet; consequently no task guarantees that an EBM will be trained.
FR-004 requires generation of partial dependence and shape‑function plots. Task T009 depends on a trained EBM (which is skipped), so the requirement is not satisfied.

FR-005 calls for validation of feature‑importance rankings against independent physical properties. Tasks T010 and T011 are conditional on a trained model; without $T_g$ data they are never executed, leaving the requirement unimplemented.
SC-001 demands that the EBM’s R² exceed a linear‑regression baseline by ≥0.05. No task computes a baseline linear model or records the required improvement; only T008 records the EBM’s R².

SC-002 requires reporting the correlation between the top‑3 feature importances and the independent physical metrics. While T010 performs a correlation, it is conditional on a trained model that never materializes, so the success criterion cannot be measured.

SC-003 specifies a sensitivity analysis with ±10 % perturbations and reporting of $T_g$ shift statistics. Task T011 is conditional on model training and therefore will not run, leaving the criterion untested.
SC-004 requires verification that total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h. Task T013 only sets a GitHub Actions timeout but does not record the actual elapsed time, so compliance cannot be demonstrated.

SC-005 expects successful generation of partial dependence plots for at least three key descriptors. Task T009 is conditional on a trained model and thus will be skipped, providing no evidence that this criterion is met.
